title: Simultaneous affine strictly-perfect residue model data
statement: For the geometric setup of new-picard-derived-fibre-residue-bridge, choose one affine neighbourhood of the marked point and strictly-perfect source and target complexes representing the localized derived direct images, with the evaluation-kernel prime ideal.

proof.text: Use properFlat_single_derivedDirectImage_perfect for the base changes of f and each fi. The private tensorPullback_invertible_local helper obtains an adjunction from nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction in TensorPullback and uses uniqueness of left adjoints to identify tensor pullback with ordinary pullback; ordinary pullback preserves invertibility. Invertibility supplies finite presentation and flatness over the flat structural maps. This gives IsPerfect for the source E and each Ei. No sectionwise normalization of the adjunction unit is used.

At w, the definition of IsPerfect gives a strictly perfect local representative for E and every Ei. Intersect the source neighbourhood with the finite intersection indexed by Fin n, and choose an affine neighbourhood U of w inside the result using the affine basis. For n = 0 the indexed intersection is top, so the same construction works.

Restrict each complex to U by overMap. Restriction preserves zero objects, finite coproducts of the unit and the maps splitting each term off a finite free module, so the restricted complexes remain strictly perfect with their original degree bounds. The natural overFunctorMap, mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryFactors isomorphisms transport all representing isomorphisms to U; the private restriction helpers prove these facts directly.

Take p to be the kernel of evaluation into the residue field at w. Mathlib RingHom.ker_isPrime proves primality directly because the codomain is a field. Combine this with the affine-open witness, the restricted complexes and their representing isomorphisms.

N4 restores the quarantined proof and fixes the overFunctor coefficient universe. E4 removes the unused canonical-adjunction dependency, proves pullback invertibility once in a private helper, and uses it for the source and finite target family.

theorem picard_derived_fibre_residue_model_data
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {n : ℕ}
    (Xi : Fin n → Scheme.{v}) (fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [∀ i, Flat (fi i)] [∀ i, IsProper (fi i)]
    [∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (fi i)]
    (ui : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (hui : ∀ i, ui i ≫ f = fi i)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (τ : (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).ringCatSheaf) :
    let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
    let Ei := fun i ↦ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd (fi i) k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback (fi i) k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) k)).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L)))
    ∃ (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U), IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) (_ : p.IsPrime)
        (hp : p = RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom)
        (K : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
        (C : Fin n → CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ),
        IsStrictlyPerfect W U K ∧ (∀ i, IsStrictlyPerfect W U (C i)) ∧
        Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
          (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ∧
        (∀ i, Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
          (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj (Ei i) ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj (C i)) )
